name: Hadithly launch health
description: Private grouped statistics. Environment: development. UTC days settle after 24h. Small buckets below 10 summaries are suppressed; summaries are not distinct people. Caps/expiry/process death can remove observations. Below 20 opportunities: too little data to judge. Check Convex analytics:health for current admission/export budget and lag. No revenue, retention, duration or per-reader history is measured.

panels.name: LA2 · First experience
panels.description: Ordered stages share the same local start-hour cohort: started -> language -> demo -> entry -> completed -> first reader. Divide ordered outcomes only. Window is 30 minutes and ends on process death. Demo/auth interactions may repeat; views are local sequence signals. Account outcomes use the completed Clerk resource; unknown hosted completion is explicit. These are flows, not distinct accounts.

source.query:
WITH counts AS (SELECT properties.platform AS platform, if(toDate(properties.day) >= today() - 1, 'Unsettled development verification', if(toDate(properties.day) >= today() - 8, 'Latest 7 settled days', 'Previous 7 settled days')) AS period, event AS family, properties.variant AS outcome, sum(toFloat(properties.count)) AS outcomes FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'development' AND timestamp >= today() - 15 AND timestamp < today() + 1 AND (event = 'onboarding_step' OR event = 'onboarding_completed' OR (event = 'recoverable_error' AND properties.variant IN ('authentication','authentication_recovered'))) GROUP BY platform, period, family, outcome), denominators AS (SELECT platform, period, family,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'started') AS starts,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'guest_started') AS guest_starts,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'account_started') AS account_starts,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'ordered_started') AS onboarding_starts,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'shown') AS offers,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'available') AS available_offers,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'purchase_started') AS store_starts,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome IN ('monthly_started','annual_started')) AS purchases,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome = 'restore_started') AS restores,
    sumIf(outcomes, outcome IN ('guest','account_new','account_existing','account_unknown')) AS entries
    FROM counts GROUP BY platform, period, family)
    SELECT c.platform AS platform, c.period AS period, c.family AS family, c.outcome AS outcome, c.outcomes AS total,
    multiIf(c.family = 'onboarding_completed' AND c.outcome != 'first_reader_success', d.entries,
      c.family = 'onboarding_step' AND startsWith(c.outcome,'ordered_'), d.onboarding_starts,
      c.family = 'reader_open_result' AND startsWith(c.outcome,'guest_'), d.guest_starts,
      c.family = 'reader_open_result' AND startsWith(c.outcome,'account_'), d.account_starts,
      c.family = 'reader_open_result', d.guest_starts + d.account_starts,
      c.family = 'paywall_result' AND c.outcome IN ('selected_monthly','selected_annual'), 0,
      c.family = 'paywall_result' AND c.outcome = 'confirmed', d.store_starts,
      c.family = 'paywall_result' AND c.outcome = 'purchase_started', d.available_offers,
      c.family = 'paywall_result', d.offers,
      c.family = 'purchase_result' AND startsWith(c.outcome,'restore_'), d.restores,
      c.family = 'purchase_result', d.purchases, d.starts) AS opportunities,
    if(opportunities >= 20 AND c.outcomes <= opportunities, round(100 * c.outcomes / opportunities, 1), NULL) AS percent,
    multiIf(opportunities = 0, 'Descriptive outcome total', opportunities < 20, 'Too little data to judge', c.outcomes > opportunities, 'Measurement inconsistent; investigate clipping', 'Review outcomes') AS interpretation
    FROM counts AS c JOIN denominators AS d ON c.platform = d.platform AND c.period = d.period AND c.family = d.family
    ORDER BY platform, family, outcome, period

panels.name: LA2 · Measurement health
panels.description: Latest reported admission and export budgets plus fixed recoverable operation counts. A stale or missing reported hour means check Convex before interpreting the other panels. It is not a current real-time billing readback.

source.query: SELECT properties.measurement_month AS month, max(toFloat(properties.admitted_monthly)) AS admitted_summaries, max(toFloat(properties.exported_monthly)) AS reserved_export_envelopes, max(toFloat(properties.export_failures)) AS export_failures, max(toFloat(properties.rejected_monthly)) AS rejected_summaries_month, argMax(toFloat(properties.suppressed_buckets), toFloat(properties.observed_hour)) AS suppressed_buckets_last_report, coalesce(sumIf(toFloat(properties.count), event = 'recoverable_error' AND properties.variant = 'measurement_clipped'), 0) AS clipping_markers_in_window, toDateTime(max(toFloat(properties.observed_hour)) * 3600) AS last_reported_utc FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'development' AND timestamp >= today() - 15 AND timestamp < today() + 1 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC
